title: Where the world's islands are
excerpt: I counted every island in a detailed open map of the world's shorelines: 181,588 of them, 23,150 over a square kilometre. Canada has the most, and 10.3% of the world's people live on one.
seo_description: Every island in the world mapped: 181,588 in the GSHHG shoreline, who has them, and the 841 million people who live on them.
header_alt: Title card reading 'Where the world's islands are' in dark slate and indigo on pale paper, beside a world map where every island is coloured by size, deep indigo for Greenland, Britain, Japan and Indonesia and gold threads of tiny islands along the coasts, with the text '181,588 islands' and '10.3% of people live on one'.
